name: mrscraper
description: MrScraper is a web-data extraction tool for developers building datasets and data-processing workflows. Fetch HTML from a specified URL, extract fields or paginated records as structured JSON, discover URLs through Google search, rerun saved AI or manual scrapers, and inspect stored results and account usage. A MrScraper account is required. Fetching, extraction, search, and reruns contact external websites through MrScraper. Managed general and listing extraction sends page content and the extraction prompt to a backend language model and saves a reusable scraper configuration; reruns create new stored results. Use third-party sources only where you have authorization and comply with their terms.
